proposed_action: Send a reminder notification to all users with overdue library-book returns and a one-click opt-out.
raw_reasoning:
A reminder notification to users about overdue library-book returns involves user personal data (which users are overdue) and directly contacts them. Because the action includes a one-click opt-out, that suggests a notification rather than a pre-permission message, and users may reasonably expect reminders from a library system without prior explicit consent, provided they can opt out. The key uncertainty is whether the organization already has a user relationship/policy that covers these reminders and whether “all users” truly means contacting potentially sensitive individuals without any prior communication context.  

Consent required: UNSURE  
Consent type: OPT-OUT  
Confidence: LOW
